verdict.rationale: Embedding interactive components into an existing server-rendered HTML page is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows whole-app migrations (Vite, CRA), Multi-Zones for running multiple Next.js apps under one domain, and starting as a static site or SPA. None of that documents mounting Next.js components into an existing non-Next page without rewriting it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the framework into an existing server-rendered HTML page and render interactive components without rewriting the whole page
